scenarios.title: A permanent with fading enters with fade counters
decisions: A casts Blastoderm, tapping four Forests.
B does not respond with Counterspell; both players pass and Blastoderm resolves.

variants.label: resolves
variants.expected: Blastoderm resolves and enters the battlefield with 3 fade counters on it.

variants.label: countered
variants.delta: B responds with Counterspell (tapping both Islands) and counters Blastoderm.
variants.expected: Blastoderm is countered and goes to A's graveyard; it never enters the battlefield, so no fade counters are put on anything.

scenarios.title: At its controller's upkeep a fading permanent loses a fade counter, and is sacrificed if it cannot
decisions: The beginning of A's upkeep: the fading trigger goes on the stack.
Both players pass; the trigger resolves.

variants.label: two_counters
variants.expected: A fade counter is removed: Blastoderm has 1 fade counter and stays on the battlefield.

variants.label: last_counter
variants.expected: The last fade counter is removed: Blastoderm has 0 fade counters and stays on the battlefield (it is sacrificed only when no counter can be removed).

variants.label: no_counters
variants.expected: No counter can be removed, so Blastoderm is sacrificed and is in A's graveyard.

variants.label: opponents_upkeep
variants.delta: It is B's upkeep: B is the active player.
variants.expected: The fading trigger does not fire: Blastoderm keeps its 2 fade counters and stays on the battlefield.
